question: Among Formula 1 drivers who raced during the 1950s, which drivers completed a season in that decade with the same constructor in both the first and the last race they participated in, while also taking part in at least two distinct race rounds during that season?
sql:
WITH driver_race_info AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        r.year,
        res.driver_id,
        res.constructor_id,
        r.round,
        r.race_id
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
driver_first_last AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        MIN(round) as first_round,
        MAX(round) as last_round,
        COUNT(DISTINCT round) as distinct_rounds
    FROM driver_race_info
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT round) >= 2
),
driver_constructors AS (
    SELECT 
        dfl.year,
        dfl.driver_id,
        dfl.first_round,
        dfl.last_round,
        dfl.distinct_rounds,
        drc1.constructor_id as first_constructor,
        drc2.constructor_id as last_constructor
    FROM driver_first_last dfl
    JOIN driver_race_info drc1 ON dfl.year = drc1.year AND dfl.driver_id = drc1.driver_id AND dfl.first_round = drc1.round
    JOIN driver_race_info drc2 ON dfl.year = drc2.year AND dfl.driver_id = drc2.driver_id AND dfl.last_round = drc2.round
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
    d.driver_id,
    d.forename,
    d.surname
FROM driver_constructors dc
JOIN drivers d ON dc.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE dc.first_constructor = dc.last_constructor 
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename
